description: Somos un equipo apasionados por convertir ideas ambiciosas en prototipos funcionales en poco tiempo, estamos aquí para aprender, construir algo con impacto y disfrutar el proceso. Trabajamos rápido, nos comunicamos con transparencia y valoramos la opinión de cada integrante. Planificamos antes de programar, dividimos las tareas con claridad y nos aseguramos de que todos aporten a algo de lo que se sientan orgullosos
summary:
SOW WATER helps farmers in Costa Rica restore their land, protect water sources, and prepare for environmental risks. It connects farm management with watershed conservation, recognizing that healthier land supports the water resources shared by surrounding communities.
The platform combines NASA satellite and rainfall data, local maps, and field observations to support informed decisions. Farmers can explore their watershed, understand vegetation and rainfall patterns, and plan actions to protect springs, restore riverbanks, and reduce soil erosion. They can also set restoration goals and track progress, photos, and expenses on their devices.
The alert system is designed to analyze environmental indicators and mapped hazards to highlight conditions associated with droughts, flooding, waterlogged soils, and landslides. It explains the available evidence and provides practical guidance, helping farmers recognize potential threats, take preventive action, and reduce damage to their farms and ecosystems.
With mobile access, Spanish and English interfaces, and offline access to previously loaded information, the project makes environmental information more accessible. It also supports future collaboration with ASADAS, Costa Rica’s community water associations.
details:
SOW WATER helps Costa Rican farmers restore their land, protect water sources, and prepare for environmental threats. It combines NASA rainfall and vegetation data, local maps, and field observations to connect farm decisions with watershed health.

Farmers can explore their watershed, plan restoration activities, and track goals, photos, and expenses. The alert system is designed to highlight conditions associated with droughts, floods, waterlogged soils, and landslides, explain supporting evidence, and offer preventive guidance. Operational warnings require further scientific validation.

The intended impact is healthier soils, protected springs and riverbanks, more resilient farms, and stronger collaboration with ASADAS, Costa Rica’s community water associations.

We developed the platform using React, TypeScript, Vite, and Python. It uses NASA POWER and MODIS data, NOAA climate indicators, and Costa Rican geographic datasets. Progressive Web App features support mobile access and offline browsing, while IndexedDB stores restoration plans locally. AI tools assisted development under team review.

Our creative approach connects individual farm actions with shared community water resources. We considered limited connectivity, different levels of digital literacy, accessibility, bilingual interfaces, budget constraints, data transparency, and the distinction between regional environmental indicators and conditions verified on a specific farm.
